title: FDA Approves First Factor XIa Inhibitor for Stroke
description:
On Nov 9, 2026 the FDA approved asundexian (Sunharbo), the first factor XIa inhibitor, with antiplatelet therapy for adults after a recent mild-to-moderate non-cardioembolic ischemic stroke or high-risk TIA. In the OCEANIC-STROKE trial it cut ischemic stroke by 26% (relative) with similar major bleeding (1.9% vs 1.7%), but GI bleeding was more common. It is not approved for atrial fibrillation.

Sources:
• FDA press release: FDA approves first factor XIa inhibitor to help prevent stroke (Nov 9, 2026): https://www.fda.gov/news-events/press-announcements/fda-approves-first-factor-xla-inhibitor-help-prevent-stroke-certain-adults-high-risk
• Eikelboom JW et al. Bleeding with asundexian vs placebo: OCEANIC-STROKE. Circulation 2026: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42866879/
• ClinicalTrials.gov: OCEANIC-STROKE (NCT05686070): https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT05686070
